question: Does the specified v4 keyed sampler agree across independent implementations, and which necessary constructive bodies and type/state/material paths occur in a fixed unfiltered panel?
scope: sampler implementation registration and future static census only; no world execution
expansion: proposal-major, initial-minor; retain every cell, duplicate table and negative; no filtering, repair, rejection, replacement, retry or favorable-law escalation
panel_rationale: 32 consecutive uninspected law IDs provide a bounded descriptive static census; four initial states check key separation, not four independent laws; not powered for prevalence or a behavioral success claim

draw_contract.serialization: UTF-8 compact JSON array [namespace,proposal,initial,field,index]; no ASCII escaping; exact integer decimal values
draw_contract.digest: SHA-256; first 16 hexadecimal digits interpreted as unsigned big-endian u64, then modulo range; preserve modulo bias
draw_contract.initial_indices: node_kind/node_state/structural: 0..7; scheduler: index 0; initial=requested initial state ID
draw_contract.field_policy: evaluate and log all 11 raw fields per slot even overridden/unused; each map read exactly three times per cell; no fallback, repair or caching of evaluated digests
draw_contract.record: every logical draw retains namespace/proposal/initial/field/index/modulus, exact preimage UTF-8, full digest hex, prefix u64 and reduced raw integer
draw_contract.independent_check: Rust and Python implement serialization/hash/reduction independently; the later record auditor independently rebuilds exact messages and SHA/reduction for every recorded draw and reconstructs complete outputs from raw fields
read_order: rule slots 0..7, then rule_domains insertion order, at initial=0
nodes 0..7, interleaved node_kind then node_state, at requested initial

observables.law_identity: SHA-256 of canonical ordered eight-rule list after removing only id fields; preserve duplicate bodies, slot order and all 32 proposal cells; report distinct table count separately
observables.initial_environment: complete exact JSON including both maps, all ordered draw records, eight rules, initial world, seed, resource accounting and limits; complete law and both-map identity across four initial IDs
observables.template_census: all eight slots by form and Transfer route; retain body IDs and absent templates
observables.birth_funding_pairs: same-table birth and Structural Transfer body pairs with ordered kind equality, donor-state intersection, child birth-state acceptance, transfer matter/activation; report each predicate independently
observables.birth_recycle_pairs: same-table birth/recycle body pairs with ordered kind equality, donor-state intersection and child birth-state acceptance; not actual deletion or leaf applicability
observables.child_donor_pairs: same-table birth/next-birth body pairs with first child kind versus next donor kind, child birth-state acceptance and explicit newborn resources (1,1) versus birth requirement (3,2)
observables.joined_motifs: join birth/funding/recycle/next-birth body IDs on the same birth within one table; report type-only, joint immediate-state-aligned and matter-bearing predicates separately; intersect all donor-state constraints simultaneously; no pooling across laws or initial states
observables.type_paths: for each birth donor kind follow f through the set of present birth donor kinds until missing donor or repeated kind; graph closure only, not a resource-feasible lifecycle
observables.initial_histograms: eight-node kind/state histograms and fixed resource/Contact/Structural inventories per initial cell; no pattern bindings or applicable-candidate enumeration
observables.state_limits: report unary state-write bodies and exact constructive role states; designed state coherence does not establish initial access or persistence; state drift, topology, resources and scheduling remain untested
observables.behavioral_outcomes: births/recycling/descendants/AP/maintenance/reproduction/heredity/adaptation are null with reason not_executed; static zero counts never become behavioral zeros

static_predicate_contract.ordered_kinds: birth donor P and created C must equal pair-pattern kinds [P,C] in that order
static_predicate_contract.donor_state_intersection: birth donor state and pair donor state agree or either is wildcard; no donor-state write in birth bundle
static_predicate_contract.child_birth_state_acceptance: target/donor predicate is wildcard or equals the creating birth value
static_predicate_contract.material_funding: Structural Transfer matter > 0, separately from types/states
static_predicate_contract.interpretation: all are local schema predicates; no guarantee of state reachability, affordability, leaf topology, scheduling, detector visibility or repeated events
static_predicate_contract.joint_donor_states: intersect birth, funding and recycle donor predicates in one common state set; pairwise compatibility with a wildcard birth is insufficient
static_predicate_contract.v4_correlation_check: for correctly reconstructed v4 tables, any type-compatible joined motif has matching exact constructive states and positive Structural matter; check as an engineering invariant, not an independent scientific discovery or chemistry gate

campaign.stage_order: for each of 128 fixed cells: Rust generation then Python generation; after all cells: static_report then independent_audit
campaign.launch_policy: reserve full stage wall allowance, twice that allowance in aggregate CPU, declared stage output and metadata reserve before launch; stop at first unavailable reservation
campaign.failure_policy: stop at first failed/mismatching/capped stage, preserve current prefix and all 128 planned cells including unstarted; no resumed/repeated sampled attempt
campaign.accounting: include both generators, parent checks, static report, independent audit, guards, snapshots, inventories, seals and failure receipts; compilation/mock tests precede the campaign clock
campaign.rss_policy: sampled enforcement plus reaped peak check; not a hard instantaneous bound
campaign.output_policy: all per-stage output ceilings combine stdout and stderr; artifact ceiling also includes failed/partial streams, snapshots and metadata

engineering_gate: all 128 fixed environments independently verified, all draw records correct and Rust/Python full output equality; no missing, failed, censored or replaced cells

each proposal has identical laws and both maps across four initial IDs; all ordered draw records, raw/overridden fields, eight forms, operation order/costs, resources, counters, profiles and limits match the frozen v4 literal contract
complete per-table/cell census retains negatives, duplicates and unresolved state/resource constraints; static predicates independently checked and never reported as dynamics
all source/dependency/tool/binary/input identities, per-stage and aggregate ceilings, costs, inventory and seals pass

decision.engineering_fail_or_incomplete: stop, retain all outcomes and diagnose read-only; no retry, completion of missing cells, replacement, budget extension or new favorable panel under this registration
decision.engineering_pass: static correctness/census only; publish all route counts including zeros; require a separately justified registered decision before any trajectory experiment
decision.no_selection: no motif-count success threshold, type-path admission filter, reroll to improve counts, or selection of favorable laws for longer evolution
decision.negative_scope: absence of body/type paths is descriptive for this fixed panel; static positives do not establish affordability, leaf topology or repeated events. Exact-table dynamic exclusions require their own conditional source argument; existing P01g negative gate and P01k outcomes unchanged

requirements_before_sampling: commit/push this registration, primitive vectors and static review before sampler implementation
implement only at new paths; keep all frozen adapters, Cargo files, historical generators, gates and receipts unchanged

before execution freeze, test only unhashed serialization, literal digest-prefix arithmetic, injected mock fields, synthetic report descriptors and guard bookkeeping; no v4 namespace-keyed hash call on any proposal, including tests and independent audit helpers

freeze complete sources, dependencies, tools, binaries, registrations and inputs; admission binds exact output path and 128-slot manifest policy, and must be committed/pushed before first keyed hash call

one future sampled static attempt in a fresh directory; capability preflight may probe process/RSS accounting without sampler calls before attempt creation; once started, write all 128 planned cells before any sampler or independent hash-audit call; no candidate enumeration, transition interpreter, native worker or detector

effective_rule_contract.constructive: birth donor state s(P), child kind f(P), newborn state s(f(P)); Structural funding and recycle patterns [P,f(P)] with exact states [s(P),s(f(P))]; Structural funding matter=1
effective_rule_contract.unchanged: other forms including Contact transfer retain raw v3 semantics; Structural transfer activation remains amount+1; all operation order, costs, eight slots, initial resources/topology, caps and detector thresholds unchanged
effective_rule_contract.raw_policy: all eleven fields required, drawn and recorded even when overridden; no insertion, conditioning, wildcard repair, resampling or selection

comparison_policy: new namespace changes every keyed field and initial world; this panel is not paired with P01k, not an estimate of v4 superiority, and not a controlled ablation of state versus matter changes
